meaning: Enough basic information for a customer to assess a provider, not enough to automatically confirm a booking.
yes_requires: A supported provider offer to visit
At least two independent clear details: visit day, useful arrival time/period, applicable fee or total-job quote
not_required: An exact clock time when a clear arrival period is available
A separate visit fee when a clear total-job quote is available
A fixed repair price when only an inspection is being offered
no_when: The provider declines or willingness is unclear
Do not count tentative, withdrawn, contradicted or unaccepted details, callback times, customer budgets, arithmetic examples or unknown conditional fees
fee_rule: Keep visit fees, separate repair prices and combined totals distinct. A clear total-job estimate can qualify, but preserve its estimated nature and inclusions. Never relabel a combined quote as a visit fee or invent a repair amount by subtraction. An inspection fee credited or waived when work is done can qualify if that condition is clear. Zero is a known fee, not missing data.
date_rule: Resolve relative dates using the supplied call date in Asia/Kolkata. Do not silently fix contradictory dates or unusual explicit years.
exact_fields_rule: Keep visit_time null for a broad period or window even when enough_info is yes. Keep visit_fee null if only a combined job total is quoted. This policy does not alter extraction facts to make a case qualify.
uncertainty_rule: Assistant-authored labels still require human review. A yes on a case marked needs_adjudication is provisional, not approved ground truth.
scope: Current evaluation prompt policy. Existing saved labels and run results are not automatically relabeled; review old enough_info labels under this policy. No change to booking confirmation or production eligibility.
missing_fields_review: Re-read the transcript only for missing fields. Fill them only with supported information; retain supported values, leave unresolved fields null, then apply the two-of-three rule. No additional API call.
